question.original: Can MY, US, China, Japan and the UK be ranked by mortgage approval rate?

direct_answer.text: Not from these sources. Monetary approvals, reported application actions, developer receipts, lender surveys and net approval counts have incompatible denominators and populations. Show each local metric with its definition; leave a universal ranking unavailable.

claims.text: Once civilizational resource networks exist, no place needs to produce every condition of survival and development on its own. Food, energy, materials, technology, and professional capability can move across regions, allowing different places to become conditions for one another through specialization and exchange. Cities can support populations far larger than nearby land could directly feed, and highly specialized industries can exist because resource networks recombine the capabilities of many places into larger circulation. Material civilizational capacity therefore comes from sustained relations rather than a single center owning everything.
